notes: The hub can print. A Print button now sits on the recipe, the week, the chore board, the shopping lists, every wiki entry, and any PDF, photo or text file on the share — it drives the OfficeJet directly, so there's no print driver to install and nothing to set up. Things come out shaped for paper rather than for a screen: shopping lists and recipe ingredients print as two columns of tick boxes, the week prints as a day-by-day agenda, and a wiki entry prints its details, notes and upkeep dates — the page worth taping inside a cabinet door. The print box shows ink levels, tells you when the printer is out of paper instead of quietly doing nothing, and waits for the job so "printed 2 pages" means it really came out.
